WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY set_num
                   ORDER BY version DESC, id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM inventories
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
children AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS item_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS item_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs
),
walk(inventory_id, multiplier) AS (
    SELECT id, 1::BIGINT
    FROM current_inv
    WHERE set_num = '5004718-1'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ci.id, w.multiplier * c.quantity
    FROM walk w
    JOIN children c ON c.inventory_id = w.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = c.item_num
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.multiplier * ip.quantity), 0) AS total_units
FROM walk w
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = w.inventory_id
WHERE ip.part_num = '32034'
  AND ip.is_spare = FALSE;
```

-- Start with the current inventory of the top-level set
current_inv AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '80033-1'
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '80033-1')
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        e.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (
        SELECT i.id FROM inventories i 
        WHERE i.set_num = e.set_num 
          AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.set_num)
    )
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: minifigs

        ip.part_num,
        e.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = (
        SELECT i.id FROM inventories i 
        WHERE i.set_num = e.fig_num 
          AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.fig_num)
    )
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = imf.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)

WITH RECURSIVE
current_versions AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
walk AS (
    SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, 'set' AS item_kind, s.set_num AS item_num
    FROM sets s

    UNION ALL

    SELECT w.root_set, c.child_kind, c.child_num
    FROM walk w
    JOIN current_versions v
      ON v.parent_kind = w.item_kind
     AND v.parent_num = w.item_num
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = v.parent_kind
     AND c.parent_num = v.parent_num
     AND c.version = v.version
    WHERE w.item_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND c.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
),
contents AS (
    SELECT w.root_set, c.child_kind, c.child_num
    FROM walk w
    JOIN current_versions v
      ON v.parent_kind = w.item_kind
     AND v.parent_num = w.item_num
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = v.parent_kind
     AND c.parent_num = v.parent_num
     AND c.version = v.version
    WHERE w.item_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND (c.child_kind <> 'part' OR NOT c.is_spare)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS set_count
FROM (
    SELECT root_set
    FROM contents
    GROUP BY root_set
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE child_kind = 'minifig' AND child_num = 'fig-007579'
    ) > 0
       AND COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE child_kind = 'part' AND child_num = '48336'
    ) > 0
);

WITH RECURSIVE
current_versions AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
items(kind, num, multiplier, is_nested) AS (
    SELECT 'set', '45801-1', 1::HUGEINT, FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.child_kind, c.child_num, i.multiplier * c.qty, TRUE
    FROM items i
    JOIN current_versions v
      ON v.parent_kind = i.kind AND v.parent_num = i.num
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = v.parent_kind
     AND c.parent_num = v.parent_num
     AND c.version = v.version
    WHERE c.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
),
part_totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN i.is_nested THEN i.multiplier * c.qty ELSE 0 END) AS nested_qty,
        SUM(i.multiplier * c.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM items i
    JOIN current_versions v
      ON v.parent_kind = i.kind AND v.parent_num = i.num
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = v.parent_kind
     AND c.parent_num = v.parent_num
     AND c.version = v.version
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'part'
      AND NOT c.is_spare
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * nested_qty / NULLIF(total_qty, 0), 2) AS percentage
FROM part_totals;
```

MATCH (owner)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(candidate:Inventory)

--   current_version: the version of the current parent's inventory

        uc.child_num AS part_num,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN set_current_version scv ON uc.parent_num = scv.set_num AND uc.version = scv.cur_ver
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'set'
      AND uc.child_kind = 'part'
      AND uc.is_spare = FALSE
),
-- Direct nested sets of a set (from its current inventory)

    SELECT 
        uc.parent_num AS set_num,
        uc.child_num AS nested_set_num,
        uc.qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN set_current_version scv ON uc.parent_num = scv.set_num AND uc.version = scv.cur_ver
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'set'
      AND uc.child_kind = 'set'
),

    SELECT 
        uc.parent_num AS set_num,
        uc.child_num AS fig_num,
        uc.qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN set_current_version scv ON uc.parent_num = scv.set_num AND uc.version = scv.cur_ver
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'set'

      AND uc.is_spare = FALSE
),
-- Now recursively compute total parts per set
-- We'll track: (set_num, part_num, color_id, total_qty)

    -- Base case: direct parts of each set
    SELECT 
        set_num,
        part_num,
        color_id,
        qty AS total_qty
    FROM direct_parts
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: parts from nested sets
    SELECT 
        pr.set_num,
        dp.part_num,
        dp.color_id,
        pr.total_qty * dns.qty
    FROM parts_recursive pr
    JOIN direct_nested_sets dns ON pr.set_num = dns.set_num
    JOIN direct_parts dp ON dns.nested_set_num = dp.set_num
    
    UNION ALL

    FROM parts_recursive
    GROUP BY set_num

WITH RECURSIVE
theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Agents'
    UNION
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2014
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
cur_ver AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
cur_edges AS (
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, u.qty
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN cur_ver cv
      ON cv.parent_kind = u.parent_kind
     AND cv.parent_num  = u.parent_num
     AND cv.version     = u.version
    WHERE NOT COALESCE(u.is_spare, FALSE)
),
explode AS (
    SELECT ts.set_num AS root, e.child_kind, e.child_num, CAST(e.qty AS BIGINT) AS qty
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN cur_edges e
      ON e.parent_kind = 'set' AND e.parent_num = ts.set_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT x.root, e.child_kind, e.child_num, x.qty * e.qty
    FROM explode x
    JOIN cur_edges e
      ON e.parent_kind = x.child_kind AND e.parent_num = x.child_num
    WHERE x.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM explode
WHERE child_kind = 'minifig';

WITH RECURSIVE
theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Architecture'
    UNION
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2016
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
cur AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
cur_edges AS (
    SELECT e.*
    FROM u_composition e
    JOIN cur c
      ON e.parent_kind = c.parent_kind
     AND e.parent_num = c.parent_num
     AND e.version = c.version
),
explode AS (
    SELECT set_num AS root, 'set' AS kind, set_num AS num, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS mult
    FROM target_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT x.root, e.child_kind, e.child_num, x.mult * e.qty
    FROM explode x
    JOIN cur_edges e
      ON e.parent_kind = x.kind
     AND e.parent_num = x.num
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x.mult * e.qty), 0) AS total_parts
FROM explode x
JOIN cur_edges e
  ON e.parent_kind = x.kind
 AND e.parent_num = x.num
WHERE e.child_kind = 'part'
  AND NOT e.is_spare;

WITH RECURSIVE th AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Duplo'
    UNION
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
cur AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS v
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
ce AS (
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, u.qty
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN cur c ON u.parent_kind = c.parent_kind AND u.parent_num = c.parent_num
    WHERE u.version = c.v
      AND NOT COALESCE(u.is_spare, FALSE)
),
roots AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN th ON s.theme_id = th.id
    WHERE s.year = 2017
),
x AS (
    SELECT r.set_num AS root, e.child_kind, e.child_num, CAST(e.qty AS BIGINT) AS q
    FROM roots r
    JOIN ce e ON e.parent_kind = 'set' AND e.parent_num = r.set_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT x.root, e.child_kind, e.child_num, x.q * e.qty
    FROM x
    JOIN ce e ON e.parent_kind = x.child_kind AND e.parent_num = x.child_num
    WHERE x.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q), 0) AS total_parts
FROM x
WHERE child_kind = 'part';

cur_ver AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS v
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
cur AS (
    SELECT u.*
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN cur_ver cv
      ON u.parent_kind = cv.parent_kind
     AND u.parent_num  = cv.parent_num
     AND u.version     = cv.v
),
walk(root, kind, num, mult) AS (
    SELECT set_num, 'set', set_num, CAST(1 AS BIGINT)
    FROM sets
    WHERE year = 2018
    UNION ALL
    SELECT w.root, c.child_kind, c.child_num, w.mult * c.qty
    FROM walk w
    JOIN cur c
      ON c.parent_kind = w.kind
     AND c.parent_num  = w.num
    WHERE c.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)

  AND c.child_num  = '2454b'
  AND NOT COALESCE(c.is_spare, FALSE)
  AND c.color_id IN (SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Tan');

WITH RECURSIVE

    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num

edges AS (
    SELECT c.parent_kind, c.parent_num, c.child_kind, c.child_num, c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN cur

     AND c.parent_num = cur.parent_num

    WHERE NOT (c.child_kind = 'part' AND COALESCE(c.is_spare, FALSE))
),

    UNION
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
s AS (
    SELECT set_num
    FROM sets
    WHERE year = 2012
      AND theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM th)
),
ex(root, kind, num, mult) AS (
    SELECT set_num, 'set', set_num, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) FROM s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ex.root, e.child_kind, e.child_num, ex.mult * e.qty
    FROM ex
    JOIN edges e
      ON e.parent_kind = ex.kind
     AND e.parent_num = ex.num
    WHERE ex.kind <> 'part'
),
per_set AS (
    SELECT s.set_num,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ex.kind = 'part' THEN ex.mult END), 0) AS total_parts
    FROM s
    LEFT JOIN ex ON ex.root = s.set_num
    GROUP BY s.set_num
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_parts), 2) AS avg_parts_per_set
FROM per_set;

WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (

    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id

    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
edges AS (
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, u.qty
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN cur c
      ON u.parent_kind = c.parent_kind

     AND u.version = c.v
    WHERE NOT (u.child_kind = 'part' AND COALESCE(u.is_spare, FALSE))
),
targets AS (
    SELECT set_num
    FROM sets
    WHERE year = 2019
      AND theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
expl(root, kind, num, mult) AS (
    SELECT set_num, 'set', set_num, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) FROM targets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.root, ed.child_kind, ed.child_num, e.mult * ed.qty
    FROM expl e
    JOIN edges ed
      ON ed.parent_kind = e.kind
     AND ed.parent_num = e.num
    WHERE e.kind <> 'part'
),
per_set AS (
    SELECT root, SUM(mult) AS total_parts
    FROM expl
    WHERE kind = 'part'
    GROUP BY root
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.total_parts, 0)), 2) AS avg_parts_per_set
FROM targets t
LEFT JOIN per_set p ON p.root = t.set_num;

WITH RECURSIVE
cur AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS v
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
edges AS (
    SELECT u.*
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN cur c
      ON u.parent_kind = c.parent_kind
     AND u.parent_num = c.parent_num
     AND u.version = c.v
),
rec(depth, child_kind, child_num, qty, is_spare) AS (
    SELECT 0, child_kind, child_num, CAST(qty AS BIGINT), is_spare
    FROM edges
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = '45801-1'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.depth + 1, e.child_kind, e.child_num, r.qty * e.qty, e.is_spare
    FROM rec r
    JOIN edges e
      ON e.parent_kind = r.child_kind
     AND e.parent_num = r.child_num
    WHERE r.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN depth > 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END) / SUM(qty),
    2
) AS pct_from_nested
FROM rec
WHERE child_kind = 'part'
  AND NOT is_spare;
